hero.title: Authentic wood-fired *Neapolitan pizza*
hero.lede: A true Italian experience on Silver Bluff Road. Sit, relax and stay as long as you like, just like in Italy.

facts.label: The entire menu is available to go

sections.eyebrow: A dream waiting to be born
sections.title: Born from a love of *Italy*
body: Apizza di Napoli is a family owned and operated authentic wood-fired Neapolitan pizzeria. It came from Cliff Garzzillo's profound love of Italy and passion for pizza.

quote.text: To be able to share my passion for pizza was always a dream waiting to be born.

sections.title: Stay a while, *or take it home*

items.title: Wood-fired oven
items.text: Authentic Neapolitan pizza, the way it is made in Naples.

items.title: Dine in
items.text: Sit and relax as long as you like and enjoy the experience.

items.title: Take out
items.text: The entire menu is available to go, though we would love your first visit to be dine-in.

sections.title: Hungry?
sections.text: Call ahead for take out, or just come in.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to a social page or a directory listing
Hours, address and what you offer are spread across other people's sites
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the business controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add a menu, photos and news as the owner supplies them
